proposed_scoped_actions.description: A separately scoped Cloudflare Access self-hosted application for the exact private QA endpoint only; review allowed user policy, MFA and deny all unapproved principals, reject Bypass rules
Make direct Render origin unable to bypass signed Access validation; do not rely on CORS, Host, Referer or proxy header without cryptographic verification
Configure a least-privilege server-only READ SELECT access path limited to auth.sessions id,user_id,not_after. Never expose Auth schema via Data API/RPC or client-side keys
Server-owned fixed HTTPS JWKS issuer endpoints and pinned audiences, bounded cache/rotation/timeouts, no legacy insecure HS256 fallback
Each existing authorized Owner authenticates and grants independent short-lived read-only consent; store one-use replay-safe receipt with redacted audit
Only after previous gates, run isolated no-send and no-customer-write real signed owner A/B session, revoke and unauthorized tenant/store negative tests

technical_requirements.rollback: Back out by disabling newly authorized private QA route, reverting scoped staging changes after independent gate; never touch existing production or tenant endpoints without separate approval
